# Page structure: home

## Page goal

Primary keyword: same day plumber harbor city

Conversion action: book a same-day plumber visit online

Traffic source and temperature: Google search and map listings, hot

## Section 2 decision

Lead with: social proof

Why: hot traffic from local search with a simple offer gets proof first (research/01-goal-offer.md).

## Section plan

| # | Section | Its one job | Content comes from | Proof used | CTA |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hero | Land the same-day fixed-price outcome and get the booking | 01, 02, 05 | Proof 1 and 2 | Book a same-day visit |
| 2 | Social proof | Show neighbors got fixed the same day | 02, 04 | Proof 3 | none |
| 3 | Proof | Prove one-visit fixes with numbers | 04 | 92 percent one-visit | none |
| 4 | Value props | Explain fixed price, arrival text, warranty | Offer facets 2, 5, 4 | Warranty terms | Book a same-day visit |
| 5 | How it works | Make booking feel easy | 05 plan | none | none |
| 6 | FAQ and FUD reducers | Answer price and no-show fears | 02 objections | Proof 1 | none |
| 7 | Closer | Repeat the outcome and ask for the booking | 01, 05 | Proof 2 | Book a same-day visit |

## Facet placement

| Offer facet (from 01-goal-offer.md) | Section | Shown as |
|---|---|---|
| Same-day visit | Hero | headline |
| Fixed price before work | Value props | value prop 1 |
| Arrival text | Value props | value prop 2 |
| 12-month warranty | Value props | value prop 3 |
| Call-out fee credited | FAQ | FAQ answer |
